source.code:
theorem any_eq_decide_mem {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (e : α) :
    ∀ (l : List α), l.any (fun e' => decide (e' = e)) = decide (e ∈ l)
  | [] => by simp
  | a :: l => by
      rw [List.any_cons, any_eq_decide_mem e l]
      by_cases h : a = e
      · subst h; simp
      · have h' : ¬ e = a := fun h'' => h h''.symm
        simp [h, h', List.mem_cons]
